items.title: BMY Q2 Deep Dive: Growth Portfolio and Pipeline Progress Drive Upgraded Outlook
items.summary: Biopharmaceutical company Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.7% year on year to $12.97 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $49.5 billion at the midpoint came in 4.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.04 per share was 27.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
